command_line:
set -u
status=0
python3 -m pip install --target .deps 'caper==2.2.2' > pip.log 2>&1 || status=1
PYTHONPATH=.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src .deps/bin/caper --help > caper_help.txt 2>&1; /bin/echo "caper_help_status=$$?" > statuses.txt
PYTHONPATH=.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src .deps/bin/caper run --help > caper_run_help.txt 2>&1; /bin/echo "caper_run_help_status=$$?" >> statuses.txt
{
  /bin/echo '--- statuses ---'
  /bin/cat statuses.txt
  /bin/echo 'install_status='"$$status"
  /bin/echo '--- pip ---'
  /bin/sed -n '1,180p' pip.log
  /bin/echo '--- caper help ---'
  /bin/sed -n '1,180p' caper_help.txt
  /bin/echo '--- caper run help ---'
  /bin/sed -n '1,240p' caper_run_help.txt
} > caper_probe.txt
exit 0
